work_order.approach: Build one vertical slice with a single pinned aggregation convention: qualified CPL is tenant-wide, computed on read as (sum of ALL spend.observed amount_micros for the tenant) / (count of ALL lead_qualified underscore events for the tenant), exact integer division, null when volume is zero — matching how the existing dashboard already sums spend and counts qualified rows. The seeded demo is the single source of the INR 7200/3 figure: the seed file drops the three legacy spend rows and the two dot-spelled lead.qualified rows and writes one canonical 10-event journey whose single spend row IS the tenant spend, so fresh databases hold exactly one spend source and seeded dashboard, POSTed QA journey and GET /v1/metrics all read 2400000000 micros from the same rule. Legacy dot-spelled lead.qualified is a pre-measurement type that the funnel never counts. A pure measurement domain (funnel + maturity + policy bands) is consumed by POST /v1/events ingest and GET /v1/metrics, rendered by the dashboard KPI strip with maturity bars and a stale banner. Dashboard ideal shows qualified CPL/volume/coverage with badges; partial shows the stale banner plus maturity bars with data-through timestamps; loading skeleton and error panel already exist and are kept. The owner decision (Meta first, Google later, plan/brief.md) does not change this slice: measurement stays platform-agnostic and no adapter code is touched; dashboard setup copy keeps the existing connect-Meta checklist. Seam: any 4xx from POST surfaces inline field errors and never writes; dashboard read failures render the existing error panel naming the failing check with last-good timestamp and a Retry button.
assumptions: Single-operator v1: tenant resolves from optional tenant_id field (auto-creating the tenant row when unknown), else the sole existing tenant, else tenant_demo; no auth layer in this slice
Default lag model p50 48h / p90 120h via piecewise-linear maturityFor until per-account learning arrives in a later epic
Stale threshold 24h past last good sync; thresholds are constants in the measurement module

work_order.confidence_rationale: Foundation already provides envelope validation, idempotent raw_events, derived spend replay and all five dashboard shells; the slice adds pure math plus two routes with no migration and no new dependency, and the v1 rejection is answered point by point: one tenant-wide convention, one spend source, 10-event count everywhere, borrowed allocation phrase removed, qa_script list identical to the seed list.

files.change: Create src/domain/measurement.js as pure domain with no IO. GROWTH_EVENTS allowlist uses internal types: click, spend.observed, lead_created, lead_qualified (underscore only; legacy dot-spelled lead.qualified is pre-measurement and never counted), demo_booked, opportunity_created, deal_won, purchase, refund, subscription_renewed, churned, gross_margin_finalized. normaliseGrowthEvent(body, tenantId) maps event_name 1:1 to event_type for allowlisted names (unknown name yields UNKNOWN_EVENT), maps integer value+currency to payload.amount_micros (non-safe-integer value yields INVALID_MONEY), carries user/session/order references into payload while dropping raw PII fields email and phone, and requires a UTC ISO-8601 occurred_at. computeFunnel(events) aggregates tenant-wide: spend_micros is the exact integer sum of all spend.observed amount_micros, qualified_volume is the count of all lead_qualified events, qualified_cpl_micros is exact integer division spend/volume and null when volume is 0. maturityFor(ageHours) is piecewise linear through (0,0), (48,0.5), (120,1.0), clamped 0..1 (so 6h gives 0.0625). policyBand(m) maps <0.35 emergency-only, 0.35-0.70 protective, 0.70-0.90 moderate, >=0.90 strategic with a gated flag true for the strategic class below 0.90. coverageOf(events) is the share of lead_qualified events carrying a session_id or user_id reference (0 when volume 0). dataThrough(events) is max occurred_at or null. isStale(now, dataThrough, 24h) plus age copy. linkJourney(events) groups by session/user/order references only.
files.why: All funnel math and maturity gating in one testable pure module the API and pages share, with the tenant-wide convention stated in code

work_order.understanding: Issue #17 is the measurement-truth slice of epic #14: growth leads see owned qualified CPL against platform CPL with maturity badges instead of the system acting on immature conversions. The foundation (#16, done) already gives raw_events with (tenant_id, event_id) idempotency, UTC envelope validation, money micros, append-only audit and dashboard shells whose KPI strip today shows spend/qualified counts with hardcoded 0.00 coverage. Missing is the contract face (POST /v1/events for lead-through-margin growth events, privacy-aware journey graph, downstream quality funnel) and the UI face upgrade (qualified CPL/volume/coverage with maturity 0..1, lag distributions, TR-7 policy bands, maturity bars with data-through timestamps, stale banner, strategic-action gating). Out of scope: adapter reads, shadow/calibration, ad mutation. Aggregation convention pinned after the v1 rejection: qualified CPL is tenant-wide (sum of all spend.observed amount_micros divided by count of all underscore lead_qualified events, exact integer division, null at zero volume); the seed drops its legacy spend and dot-spelled qualified rows so one 10-event journey is the single INR 7200/3 source on a fresh database.
